ai.overview: Michigan State brings the Belt Holders lineal championship to Columbus to face Ohio State on December 3rd, 2026. The Spartans claimed the belt in their most recent outing and now defend it for the first time in this reign. Ohio State, who have held the belt four times previously, will look to reclaim it on home ice.
key_matchups: Michigan State's fresh belt reign versus Ohio State's historical dominance in the all-time series (33-21-6)
The Spartans' recent 2-0 shutout win over Michigan against the Buckeyes' two-game losing streak
Michigan State's 7-4-1 record this season against Ohio State's struggling 4-8 mark
ai.betting_angles: Michigan State enters as the Elo favorite despite Ohio State owning the all-time head-to-head advantage. The Spartans have won their last game and show a significantly better record at 7-4-1 compared to Ohio State's 4-8. However, the Buckeyes won three of the last five meetings between these teams, including a 3-2 victory in their most recent encounter on March 14th, 2026.
ai.prediction_writeup: Michigan State gets the nod based on their superior season record and momentum from their 2-0 shutout of Michigan. While Ohio State has historically dominated this matchup and won three of the last five meetings, the Buckeyes are currently on a two-game losing streak and have struggled to an 4-8 record. The Spartans' Elo advantage and recent defensive performance, including a 2-0 shutout and 5-0 victory in their last five games, suggest they can defend the belt in a tight road contest. Ohio State's home ice and familiarity with Michigan State keeps this competitive.
